Comment: Publish a bounded workload in sequential five-minute Lambda segments. Keep the original input and deployed generator version unchanged when retrying a run.

ProduceSegment.Comment: Wait for Kinesis acceptance of one segment. Retries reuse its original sequence offset; already accepted events retain their identity.

WorkloadComplete.Comment: Finish only after all requested seconds have been published. A 900-second input normally completes three segments.

UseNextSegmentInput.Comment: Carry the unchanged run settings and next global sequence offset into the next invocation.

Completed.Comment: Output reports accepted distinct operations and planned deliveries. Unknown network outcomes or retries can add physical deliveries; check warehouse counts separately.
